purpose: Phase 0 data generation for the judge pre-screen (docs/internal/judge-prescreen-design.md). Committed before any run; each run records this file's sha256.
stop_rule: Stop at the first of: target_eligible_rounds eligible rounds recorded under one judge identity (the largest (judge identity, datagen) cell); max_provider_calls calls; max_reported_cost_usd in provider-reported cost; the corpus exhausted after all repetitions.
go_rule: Replay runs only if `autoctx prescreen sufficiency` shows the datagen family meeting both Phase 1 conditions for one judge identity (the judge's provider, model, prompt template and score transformations; rubrics and pinned dimensions are pooled).
limitations: One provider serves generation, revision and judging. The corpus was authored for this study, so results describe these tasks, not organic traffic. The call cap bounds calls, not dollars, when a provider reports no cost.
